title: Candy Circuit
description: A playful, minimal dance pop track built around a sparkling triangle lead and a crisp CasioRZ1 kit. It opens with just melody and a soft kick, layers in hats and clap as the groove develops, blooms into a buoyant full arrangement mid-track, then peels back for a breezy outro that leaves the triangle ringing alone.
